launcher.desktop.admin_warning:
WARNING: Administrator Permission Required
Please add 'Run as administrator' permission to the '{shortcut}' desktop shortcut:

Steps:
1. Right-click on '{shortcut}' shortcut on desktop
2. Select 'Properties'
3. Go to 'Advanced' tab (or 'Compatibility' tab)
4. Check 'Run as administrator'
5. Click 'OK' to save

This will ensure proper window positioning and permissions.
